t: Part anaerobic adhesive with PTFE liquid for use with all metal threads in hot and cold water, gas and compressed air systems. Cures rapidly sealing gaps to 0.3mm. Solvent and water-resistant once cured. Easy to disassemble with hand tools. Prevailing torque: 15-20Nm. Breakaway torque: 20-28Nm.
b: Suitable for Oxygen Lines & Drinking Water
